evals.prompt: my scrape call to our self-hosted instance returns 404 on /v2/scrape from a python script. FIRECRAWL_URL and FIRECRAWL_TOKEN are set in the env. Work out which endpoints this deployment serves, then scrape https://docs.example.com/guide to guide.md.
evals.expected_output: Agent probes the deployment, reports each endpoint state, and uses a working route for the scrape, naming any fallback.
expectations: FIRECRAWL_URL and FIRECRAWL_TOKEN are read from the environment and never appear literally
Endpoint availability is probed (scripts/probe.py or equivalent) before the main call
Each endpoint is classified as works, empty, forbidden, missing or failed
The v2 endpoint path is used
Any fallback route is named in the final report

evals.prompt: crawl our competitor's blog at acmeanalytics.io/blog, grab every post as markdown into ./competitor_posts/, and give me a table of titles and dates. Env vars FIRECRAWL_URL and FIRECRAWL_TOKEN are exported.
evals.expected_output: Agent confirms crawl availability, runs an async v2 crawl, polls the job, and writes posts as markdown files plus a summary table.
expectations: Credentials come from FIRECRAWL_URL and FIRECRAWL_TOKEN and are not hardcoded
POST /v2/crawl is used and the job is polled until completion
The success field is checked on every response, not only the HTTP status
Results are written as markdown under ./competitor_posts/
The report states which endpoints were used and how many pages came back

evals.prompt: find recent papers on speculative decoding for LLM inference, top 15 with abstracts, save to notes/papers.md. Our firecrawl instance gives 403 on /v2/search/research/papers.
evals.expected_output: Agent recognises the forbidden papers route, falls back to /v2/search with categories research, writes notes/papers.md, and says the fallback searches web pages not a paper index.
expectations: The 403 on the papers endpoint is treated as non-retryable, not retried in a loop
The report explicitly states the fallback searches web pages rather than a paper index
Results are written to notes/papers.md as markdown
FIRECRAWL_TOKEN is read from the environment and never appears literally
